body: Dear Ms. Ortega,

The book you requested, Introduction to Urban Design, is now available at the main circulation desk. Please collect it within five days. Holds that are not picked up in time are returned to the shelves and offered to the next reader in line.
You may renew the loan online once, unless another student has requested the same title.
Regards,
David Ruiz, Circulation Services

The special exhibition on the third floor is not included and still requires a separate ticket. Visitors are encouraged to arrive early, as lines form quickly after six o'clock.

read_in_daily_life.subject: Weekly Language Exchange - New Format
body: Dear Members,
From October, our Wednesday meetings will follow a new format. The first hour will be reserved for beginners, and the second hour will be open to conversation at any level.

Members no longer need to register in advance, but the room holds only thirty people. Snacks will be provided by volunteers rather than the club budget, so please bring something to share when you can.
Warm regards,
The Club Committee

body: Beginning January 1, the price of a monthly transit pass will increase, while single-ride tickets will stay the same. Students and seniors will continue to receive a reduced rate.

Passes bought in December at the current price will remain valid until they expire. Riders can load passes at any station machine or through the transit app, which will be updated at the end of December.
